definition: An ECS task runs the containers described by one task definition together.
A pod is the Kubernetes workload unit that EKS schedules onto Fargate compute.
A sidecar is a container that runs alongside an application container in the same task.
A task definition describes an ECS container workload and its resource and networking requirements.
A platform version identifies the kernel and container runtime environment for a Fargate task.
A revision updates a Fargate platform version without changing its version identifier.
A namespace groups Kubernetes pods for selection by an EKS Fargate profile.
A DaemonSet is a Kubernetes workload pattern for running a daemon on nodes and is unsupported on Fargate.
Static provisioning prepares persistent file storage before a pod consumes it.
An ENI is the virtual network interface that gives a Fargate task its VPC address.
An interface VPC endpoint gives resources private-address access to a service API.
An S3 gateway endpoint supplies a route-table path to S3 for image-layer downloads.
A NAT gateway provides outbound internet connectivity for tasks with private IPv4 addresses.
An image layer is a part of a container image that ECR stores in S3 for downloading.
A manifest describes the image layers a client downloads for a container image.
The execution role gives ECS and Fargate agents permissions for image pulls and other task startup operations.
A task role grants AWS API permissions to application code inside task containers.
